services.name: Boat Rental
services.desc: Whether you’re a first-time “canal-er,” a family of four, or planning a getaway with a group of couples, our team is here to help you find the ideal vessel to fit your needs. Explore layout drawings and immersive photos below to get to know our fleet-and start imagining your perfect Erie Canal adventure. Our luxury model boat, The Harriet, is perfect for one couple seeking an elegant and spacious getaway. Enjoy a private cabin with a queen-sized bed, a private bathroom featuring a large shower with hot running water, a full kitchen, and an enclosed helm area.
